findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Dirty dishes were in the handwashing sink upon arrival.  Discussed with PIC, who removed them.  Ensure the handwashing sink is only used for handwashing.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer sink in the 3 part sink had a concentration of less than 50 ppm (cl) at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC, more chlorine was added to bring the concentration up to 75 ppm.  Ensure the sanitizer concentration is check after making to ensure dishes are properly sanitized.

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
No test strips for quat sanitizer wipes were available at time of inspection.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the facility has quat and chlorine test strips to properly test the concentration of sanitizer used in the facility.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Multiple floor tiles were observed to be missing along the wall near the grill under the hood.  Member present stated a piece of equipment was there had been recently moved.  Ensure floor tiles are replaced to prevent soil and food accumulation in areas not easily cleanable.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.16: Perimeter walls and roofs of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall effectively protect the establishment from the weather and the entry of insects, rodents, and other animals.

Seal kitchen to-go window, replace weather stripping, to prevent potential entry of pests to establishment. Discussed with PIC.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a bag of taco meat stored in the freezer with no label. Provide a label on the bag of frozen taco meat in the freezer.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the microwave to be soiled. Clean the microwave.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
1). Observed wiping cloths laying on the counters in the kitchen. 2). Obsereved wiping cloths laying on the counter behind the bar. Store wiping cloths in a sanitizer bucket or their designated area.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1). Observed the ice machine deflector shield in the kitchen to be soiled with what appears to be mold. 2). Observed the ice machine deflector shield behind the bar to be soiled with what appears to be mold. Clean both ice machine deflector shields.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the microwave in the kitchen to be soiled with food debris. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the microwave in the kitchen.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed two spray bottles with no labels. Provide labels on all toxic items.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
WHEN REMODEL::Ceiling tile in the bar area--restrooms --are with pitted -not smooth or easily cleanable.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.comment:

findings.comment:
Observed  a leak in the 3 compartment sink faucet. Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
